purpose: Test whether confidence on joint reconstruction improves SDCN, then check FP versus zero under degree-biased node attribute missingness
hardware: CPU; existing pytorch environment; no GPU driver change
code_note: Stage-five runs started from these byte-identical script snapshots. Stage-four scripts were restored afterward and verified against the stage-four manifest.

random_missing_ablation.location: Joint reconstruction loss only; pretraining and KL remain uniform
random_missing_ablation.uniform_reference: sdcn_stage4_holdout/results.json with matching mask and seed
random_missing_ablation.analysis: Paired final-epoch ACC, NMI and ARI; report all comparisons, no label-based model selection

different_missing_setting.analysis: Paired FP minus zero at final epoch, plus overlap and missing-node degree diagnostics

boundary: This is one dataset under two missingness mechanisms; it does not establish cross-dataset generalization or paper-level novelty
